arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Kevin Russell argued the briefing narrowed the disagreement among the parties.
Russell stated that ignorance of the law is no excuse.
Ms. Harrington argued a broader view of knowledge is correct.
Harrington stated the government need not limit knowledge specifically to drug laws.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: The outcome defines the mental state required for federal drug convictions. It sets the standard for proving a defendant knew the substance was illegal. This standard affects how prosecutors build cases against drug sellers. It determines the scope of criminal liability under federal law.
